purpose: F0.2 source inventory; classifications are migration obligations, not implementation or gameplay approval

bag.field.result: item/context operation or ITEM_NONE; return to field menu

bag.battle.result: gSpecialVar_ItemId -> CompleteWhenChoseItem; effects belong to battle rules

bag.target.result: selected item -> original party/storage caller; no second inventory

bag.shop.result: sale/deposit quantity, confirmation/error; return to shop/item PC

bag.script.result: selected item or cancel in script variables; restore script wait state
bag.script.entrypoints: CB2_ChooseBerry CB2_ChooseMulch ChooseBerryForMachine FavorLadyOpenBagMenu QuizLadyOpenBagMenu ApprenticeOpenBagMenu

bag.tutorial.result: script-controlled selection; temporary inventory must be restored

bag.pyramid.result: Pyramid inventory/rules kept distinct from ordinary bag; same application lifecycle

party.field.result: selected mon/context, reorder or field move; restore caller

party.battle.result: gSelectedMonPartyId + order; battle cancel PARTY_SIZE; forced selection cannot cancel

party.item.result: target, held item/mail, move slot, validated effect or denial; restore bag/party

party.script.result: party index/order or PARTY_NOTHING_CHOSEN through each caller's contract
party.script.entrypoints: ChoosePartyMon ChooseMonForDaycare ChooseContestMon ChooseMonForMoveTutor ChooseMonForMoveRelearner InitChooseHalfPartyForBattle BattlePyramidChooseMonHeldItems

party.multi.result: party owner + layout + selected order; do not use player slots for partner

party.link.result: compatibility boundary: native PC transport absent, preserve safe return; no network implementation in this scope

summary.read.result: last viewed index + exit callback; party and BoxPokemon payloads are different

summary.move.result: slot 0..MAX_MON_MOVES-1; cancel MAX_MON_MOVES; learner/deleter applies change

menu.dex.result: read/query shared dex; return with cursor/context

menu.map.result: navigation/query, no warp unless explicit Fly destination confirmed
menu.map.entrypoints: CB2_InitPokeNav FieldInitRegionMap OpenPokenavRegionMap CB2_OpenFlyMap ShowRegionMapForPokedexAreaScreen SetFlyDestination

menu.profile.result: profile/Frontier Pass read and original return

menu.navigation.result: exit/retire/confirmation releases field locks and clock ownership

menu.debug.result: QA boundary; not the playable HGSS interface

menu.disabled.result: DexNav disabled by configuration; reclassify if enabled

naming.result: encoded name in supplied destination buffer; return callback/limits

battle.core.result: action/move/target/gimmick result -> engine; complete controller command once

battle.special.result: tutorial/Safari/Frontier/recorded autonomous controllers; not live move input

sentinel.result: count/keep/last is metadata, never a selectable option

unused.result: explicit unused legacy constant; no new feature authorized

groups.party.script: CONTEST CHOOSE_MON CHOOSE_HALF DAYCARE MOVE_RELEARNER STORE_PYRAMID_HELD_ITEMS

groups.party.multi: MULTI MULTI_SHOWCASE MULTI_FULL MULTI_FULL_PARTNER MULTI_FULL_SHOWCASE MULTI_FULL_SHOWCASE_PARTNER
